name: Traders’ Weight
body:
School divination; Level adept 0, inquisitor 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a tiny model scale)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one object up to 100 lbs./level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You divine the exact weight an object touched, and gain a +2 insight bonus to Appraise checks when determining the value of the object if weight is a factor (a bag of copper or a barrel of wine, for example, but not art or weapons).
